N.C. College · Dept. of BCA · Batch 2017

The wait is finally over!

From sharing classroom benches to bunking lectures, from canteen conversations to unforgettable trips, we have created memories that stay forever. Life took us in different directions, but it’s time to bring everyone back together. Let’s reunite, relive those crazy moments and create new ones!

Once a batchmate, always a batchmate!
